name: The ancient world
heading: Video games set in the ancient world
intro: Egypt, Greece, Rome and the cities before them. Many of the places from this era can still be visited as ruins and in museums.

name: The Middle Ages
heading: Video games set in the Middle Ages
intro: Castles, cathedrals, crusades and plague years, between the fall of Rome and the age of exploration.

name: The early modern era
heading: Video games set in the Renaissance and early modern era
intro: From the Italian Renaissance to the age of sail and the revolutions that followed, between 1500 and 1836.

name: The Victorian era
heading: Video games set in the Victorian era
intro: Industrial cities, empire and the American frontier, from 1837 to 1901.

name: World War I
heading: Video games set in World War I
intro: The war of 1914 to 1918: trenches in France and Belgium, the Eastern Front and the railways of Europe.

name: The 1920s and 1930s
heading: Video games set in the 1920s and 1930s
intro: Jazz-age cities, Prohibition, the Depression and the years before the next war.

name: World War II
heading: Video games set in World War II
intro: The war from 1939 to 1945, from Normandy and Stalingrad to the Pacific and the occupied cities of Europe.

name: The Cold War
heading: Video games set in the Cold War
intro: The decades from 1946 to 1991 when the United States and the Soviet Union stood against each other, from Berlin and Moscow to Havana and Vietnam.

name: The 1990s
heading: Video games set in the 1990s
intro: The decade after the Berlin Wall fell, and the years the internet reached ordinary homes.

name: The 2000s
heading: Video games set in the 2000s
intro: The years from 2000 to 2009: the war on terror, the first smartphones and the financial crisis.

name: The 2010s
heading: Video games set in the 2010s
intro: The decade from 2010 to 2019, with smartphones in every pocket, streaming and the Arab Spring.

name: The 2020s
heading: Video games set in the 2020s
intro: The years we are living in now, from 2020.

name: The future
heading: Video games set in the future
intro: Games set after 2026: near-future cities and worlds far beyond.
